newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK 338 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK 338 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said it sold 338 million kuna in 35- and 91-day bills on Wednesday.
The volume jumped from 109 million issued at last week's auction, but rates were unchanged for seven consecutive weeks.
The 35-day bills were issued in volume of 306 million kuna at 8.0 percent, and banks placed 32 million in 91-day paper at 9.5 percent.

Monday's reserve payment drained 3.3 billion kuna from the banking system, 53.8 million more than under the previous requirement, a bank official told Reuters. -- Sandra Kalogjer, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
